body:
A good product page tells you everything you need to decide: what the product is, how strong, how large, what it costs, how it is shipped and what happens if there is a problem. A poor one tells you a lot about the style and not much about the substance. This guide walks through the parts of a vape product page and what each tells you, what to check before you buy, what warning signs to look for, how to use the variant selector, how to read prices and shipping notes, how to read the description and FAQ, what policies to check and how to compare two pages. It is written for adults aged 21 and over. Nicotine is addictive, and nothing here is medical advice.

## Start with the title
The title should state the brand, the product line and the flavor. For example, a brand name, a series name and a flavor such as "Blue Razz Ice". If the title is vague, or only a flavor, be careful. A clear title tells you which product you are getting and lets you compare it with others.

## The image
Product photos should show the device and the packaging. Check that the image shows the same flavor and product as the title. Our images are local, high-definition photos, so what you see is the product line you are buying. Be wary of pages with blurry, mismatched or stolen images, and of images that show a different product.

## Price
The price should be in US dollars, with no hidden fees. Some products show a range, because different pack sizes or strengths cost different amounts. Use the selector to see the price for each option. Remember that our minimum order is $100, and orders of $200 or more after discount ship free. Cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10 percent at checkout. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).

## The variant selector
Many products come in several strengths or pack sizes, such as 5 pack or 10 pack. The selector lets you choose, and the price updates for your choice. Check that you have the right option before adding to cart, because the cart shows each option as its own line. If you want a different strength, choose it before you add. See [nicotine strength guide](/blog/nicotine-strength-guide/).

## Key specifications
Look for:
- **Nicotine strength,** as a percentage or mg/mL.
- **Puff count,** which is a maker's estimate, not a guarantee. See [puff counts explained](/blog/puff-count-explained/).
- **Battery capacity,** in mAh, and whether it is rechargeable.
- **Liquid capacity,** in mL.
- **Coil type,** such as mesh.
- **Charging port,** such as USB-C.
- **Pack size.**

If a page leaves these out, ask us through the [contact page](/contact/) before you buy.

## The description
A good description explains what the product is, how it is used and what to expect, in plain terms. Ours run to several hundred words, and they are written from the product's data, not copied from the maker. Be cautious about descriptions that make health claims, promise miracle results or use vague superlatives. We do not make health claims, and nicotine is addictive.

## The FAQ
Many pages include a list of questions and answers: what is the strength, is it rechargeable, how many puffs, how do I charge it, what is the return policy and so on. These are a quick way to check details. Compare the answers with the specification.

## Reviews and ratings
Look for real, attributable reviews. We do not invent reviews, ratings or statistics, and if a product has no reviews, we do not show any. Be wary of pages with perfect scores and no names, or ratings that appear instantly. See [how to spot counterfeit vapes](/blog/how-to-spot-counterfeit-vapes/).

## Shipping and delivery notes
A product page should link to shipping terms. Ours say orders are processed in 24 to 72 business hours, shipped by regional carriers, and need an adult signature (21+) on delivery. West Coast delivery takes about 3 to 7 business days, and eastern states about 11 to 18. See [shipping times from Phoenix](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Returns and refunds
Check the return terms before you buy. Ours: returns must be requested within 30 days with an RMA, opened or used items cannot be returned, a 15 percent restocking fee applies and refunds go back through the original payment method. Puffco products are excluded. See our [refund policy](/refunds/).

## Age and compliance notices
A responsible page states that the product is for adults aged 21 and over, carries a nicotine warning and mentions state restrictions. Be cautious about pages that do not mention age at all.

## Comparing two pages
Put the two products side by side. Compare strength, puff count, battery, liquid, price per puff and shipping terms. Then compare the policies. A product that is slightly cheaper but has no returns policy may cost you more. See [how to compare vape prices per puff](/blog/how-to-compare-vape-prices-per-puff/).

## Warning signs
- **No strength listed.**
- **Prices far below market.**
- **Generic or mismatched images.**
- **Health claims.**
- **No age notice.**
- **No contact or policy pages.**
- **Only unusual payment methods with no explanation.**

## A worked example
You are comparing two pages for similar 30,000-puff disposables. Page A lists the strength, battery, liquid and coil, has a clear price of $18.99, shows shipping terms and a 30-day return policy and carries an age notice. Page B shows a flavor name, a price of $9.99, no strength, no policy links and no age notice. Page A is the one to trust. The cheap price on Page B is a reason to be cautious, not a bargain.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Why do some products show a price range?
Because options such as pack size or strength cost different amounts. Select an option to see its price.

### Are puff counts exact?
No. They are estimates and depend on how you use the device.

### Why does my cart show two lines for one product?
Each option is its own line, so two strengths appear separately.

### Can I ask questions before buying?
Yes, through the contact page.

### Where do I see the age notice?
On the product page and at checkout.

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A checklist you can keep
Before you add a product to your cart, tick through these points.
- Does the title name the brand, line and flavor?
- Is the nicotine strength listed, and do I understand the unit?
- Is the puff count, battery and liquid capacity given?
- Does the price match the option I selected?
- Is there an age notice and a nicotine warning?
- Are shipping and return terms linked?
- Is the description specific, with no health claims?
- Is there a way to contact the seller?
- Does the total, including shipping, meet my budget and the $100 minimum?

If you tick them all, you can buy with more confidence. If you cannot, ask a question first.

## Understanding the cart and checkout
Your cart lists each product, option and quantity, with a line total. Check each line, particularly strengths and pack sizes. At checkout, you choose a payment method. Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime are first in our list, followed by cryptocurrency and gift cards, which save 10 percent. The server re-checks prices for every line, so what you see at checkout is what you pay. See [payment methods explained](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

## Reading the delivery estimate
The estimate depends on your location. Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours. Transit is about 3 to 7 business days to Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho, and about 11 to 18 to the eastern half of the country. An adult aged 21 or over must sign. If you will not be home, choose an address where an adult can sign, and read [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## Questions to ask us
If a page leaves something out, send us a message. Useful questions include: what is the strength of this option, is it rechargeable, what is the puff count, which pods fit this device and what are the dimensions. Include the product name and, if you are asking about an order, your order ID. We will answer from the product data, and we will tell you if we do not know.

## What a trustworthy page does not do
It does not promise health benefits. It does not make claims about health, or say it treats or prevents anything. It does not invent reviews or statistics. It does not hide fees or terms. It does not push you with fake countdowns. If you see any of these, treat the page with caution.

## When the page and the box disagree
Occasionally, the product that arrives differs from the page: a different strength, a new packaging design or a changed puff count. Makers update products, and photos sometimes lag. If you notice a difference that matters, such as strength, take a photo of the packaging and message us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID before you use the product. Keep the packaging, because it helps us check the batch. We will tell you what we can and what applies under our [refund policy](/refunds/).
